name: smwgraphics-super-metroid-fog
title: Super Metroid - Fog
description:
The ominous fog in Super Metroid when you enter old Tourian the first time or before the golden statues.

Note that this is a fullscreen tilemap , you will need a status bar workaround like this and enabling CGADSUB is highly recommend. If it strictly needs to be a vertical level, use this UberASM code:
Collapse Text
Code
init:
    LDA #$04
    STA $0D9D|!addr
    STA $212C
    STA $212E
    LDA #$13
    STA $0D9E|!addr
    STA $212D
    STA $212F
RTL
